description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340005531814 CAP,PROTECTIVE,DUST: Line 0001 Qty 349 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0117 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
